methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
OSH Cut is a bootstrapped robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Chamberlain and Jacom Chamberlain. The valuation universe consists of 10 peers operating in Robotics & Manufacturing, comprising 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The narrow peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—zero bootstrapped or early-stage robotics companies with comparable valuation tiers were identified in the available data. A full-sector median approach would be misleading given the pronounced stage and scale heterogeneity within the broader robotics cohort. This constraint eliminates the primary triangulation method available.

The analysis cannot support a specific valuation range at this time. Without sufficient comparable data points filtered to stage, maturity, and valuation proximity, quantitative triangulation is not defensible. Key uncertainties include the lack of early-stage robotics benchmarks and the limited information on OSH Cut's revenue, unit economics, or capital requirements. A credible valuation would require either (1) access to a larger database of bootstrapped manufacturing-tech companies, (2) direct financial disclosure from OSH Cut enabling first-principles analysis, or (3) execution of alternative methods such as venture capital method or discounted cash flow analysis, none of which are supported by the current dataset.
